title: Poison floor pin targets _missing_metadata_floor branch, not the tracker-consumed _floor_result_locked branch
description: python/tests/timing/test_time_sync.py:755-758 (78hj follow-up): the added evaluate_epoch_floor(FLOOR, None, verifier=...) assertion routes through _missing_metadata_floor (provisioning.py:629-630), but StratumTracker._validate_active_at_live_generation_locked (stratum.py:519-521) consumes the _floor_result_locked persistence_failed branch (provisioning.py:596-597) via EpochFloorAuthority._with_snapshot -> _with_floor_snapshot — that branch is untested repo-wide, so a regression deleting only the :596 check passes the pin while trackers stop clearing active clocks on persistence failure. Strengthen with ~2 lines: EpochFloorAuthority(FLOOR, verifier=verifier).current().provision_status is ProvisionEpochStatus.PERSISTENCE_FAILED (routes 777->592->596). Context: current() is None / minimum_record_version == 0 are non-discriminating for poison on a virgin verifier (any raise-at-persist leaves them so); minimum_record_version still kills a commit-before-persist reordering mutant, but as a poison pin it is dead weight. Optional hardening: add assert verifier.cleared (mirror sibling clear-path pin at :789).
